words.gloss: by the mind / from the heart

literal: By the mind without lying if one conducts oneself, of the world's people in the minds of all, he will exist.
translation: If one conducts oneself without deceit in one's own heart, one will dwell in the hearts of all people in the world.
modern: ஒருவர் தன் நெஞ்சறியப் பொய் சொல்லாமல் வாழ்ந்தால், அவர் உலகத்தில் உள்ள எல்லாருடைய மனங்களிலும் வாழ்வார்.
explanation: This couplet explains the profound power of inner truthfulness. If a person lives their life without harboring falsehood in their own mind, they earn a permanent place in the hearts of everyone in the world. True truthfulness is not merely about spoken words, but about absolute inner honesty. By being pure in thought, such a person becomes universally loved and remembered.
